warnings.message: user app on web is also in groups adm, sudo, which the declaration does not name: Mamela adds memberships and never removes one, so they stay
warnings.hint: declare the group if it is meant, or take the user out of it by hand (gpasswd -d app adm)

warnings.message: user app on web is a system user (uid 998), but is declared as a user (not a system user): Mamela does not change that, which only says how the user is made
warnings.hint: declare system: true to match the node
